description: County courthouse pins for the MapLibre map page (phase P5). Every url must be an official host (see that state's official_hosts in data/states/<ST>.yaml; enforced by scripts/validate.mjs). Pins never carry identity fields and never imply ticket search.

address.description: Street address of the building the pin marks.

county.description: County name; must exist in data/states/<ST>.yaml.

name.description: Display name shown in the map popup.

state.description: Two-letter code; must match the file name.

url.description: Official page for this pin's agency. No identity fields are collected on our side. https:// required; http:// only for an official site with human-verified broken TLS, documented in verification_note.

link_check.description: manual = bot-blocked but human-verified; check-links.mjs skips these and reports them.

verification_note.description: Required when link_check is manual, or when url uses http (must document the broken TLS).

title: TicketRouter map pins
